observed.effect: No spec-first source patch; route to a portable Agent Skill authoring workflow.
observed.layer_result: Reusable job qualifies as a skill, but the target repository lacks the required spec-first ownership, governance, catalog, and projection contracts.
observed.response: 这是可复用任务，但不应套用 spec-first 的治理和 runtime 投影约定。改走通用 Agent Skill authoring：在项目约定的 skills 目录创建 kebab-case package，写清 API 变更输入、兼容性清单输出、正负触发边界，并只添加被入口引用的必要 references/evals；先确认该仓库的宿主、安装位置和验证命令。
observed.source_owner_assumption: The ordinary Node.js repository owns the package under its own conventions; no spec-first source owner is assumed.
